item.title: Street Fighter 6 balance update announced to be coming with Alex's release
item.description: <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/21/alex-gameplay-trailer-sf6/">Alex has been getting a lot of attention lately after receiving his gameplay trailer</a> for Street Fighter 6 last week, and it seems he won't be coming alone.</p> <p>Capcom just confirmed tonight that they will be implementing a wider balance update for Street Fighter 6 at the same time.</p>

item.title: Don't go believing the new supposed Street Fighter 6 Season 4 DLC character 'leak' floating around the internet
item.description: <p>Street Fighter 6 fans have been hungry for new content for months now, and they'll seemingly be waiting a while longer to receive the next substantial update.</p> <p>Although <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/21/alex-gameplay-trailer-sf6/">Alex is on the way as the third Season 3 DLC character</a>, there's been some talk floating around lately about who will be showing up in Street Fighter 6 Season 4.</p>

item.title: Alex's character select screen, intro and versus face animations revealed for Street Fighter 6
item.description: <p>Alex may still be almost two months away from releasing in <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/">Street Fighter 6</a>, but we've been seeing a lot of the big boy in motion lately.</p> <p>Capcom just released a new video showcasing all of Alex's pre-fight animations in Street Fighter 6.</p>

item.title: 2XKO Director releases statement on Ranked, console and gameplay issues being worked on
item.description: <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/19/season-1-patch-notes-2xko/">2XKO finally reached its full release last week</a> over six years after the game was initially teased at Evo 2019.</p> <p>Everything hasn't gone as smoothly for the launch of the League of Legends fighting game, however, which even the developers would admit to.</p>
